plan.summary: The user is a 16-year-old who prefers home workouts, aims to build strength, and likes exercising alone. They have 30 minutes a week to commit to their fitness goal, broken down into 3 sessions of 10 minutes. The user seeks a personalized plan to achieve their strength goal.

shortTerm: start with bodyweight exercises like push-ups, squats, and lunges
explore online resources for strength training routines
invest in a set of resistance bands
longTerm: progress to more challenging exercises like pull-ups and dips
incorporate progressive overload to increase strength
consider working with a virtual personal trainer
actionItems: research 3 bodyweight exercises to start with
watch 2 online tutorials on proper form and technique
purchase a set of resistance bands within the next 2 weeks

nextSteps: research and create a list of 3 bodyweight exercises to start with
watch online tutorials on proper form and technique
purchase a set of resistance bands and schedule workouts for the next week
